label: Finding & Observation Writer
description: Write clear, impactful audit findings using the 5C framework. Turn test results into well-structured findings that drive remediation.

guidedInputs.label: Describe what you found
guidedInputs.description: What did the testing reveal? Include specific numbers, percentages, examples.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., In 8 of 20 sampled files (40%), the required EDD documentation was absent. 3 of these were PEP customers. The files were opened between March and October 2024.

guidedInputs.label: What should it be? (criteria)
guidedInputs.description: The regulation, policy, or standard that was not met.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., AMLR Article 36 requires EDD for PEP customers including source of wealth documentation. Internal CDD Policy v2.1 Section 4.3 requires EDD completion within 10 days of PEP identification.

guidedInputs.label: Why did it happen? (your view of root cause)
guidedInputs.description: Structural cause, not just 'human error'. Why were staff in a position to make this error?
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., The CDD system does not prompt for EDD when a PEP flag is set; the step is manual and reliant on staff awareness.

guidedInputs.label: Additional context (optional)
guidedInputs.placeholder: Relevant background, aggravating or mitigating factors, prior findings on the same issue...
